title: chamaecrista coriacea
intro: Chamaecrista coriacea, commonly known as the sensitive plant, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is native to tropical Africa and is known for its ability to fold its leaves in response to touch. The health benefits of Chamaecrista coriacea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress.
